gaps.sentence: ___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
He joined ___ army when he was eighteen.
gaps.explanation: Institutions take 'the': the army, the police, the church.

gaps.sentence: He spent three years in ___ United States.
She works in ___ insurance, not banking.
gaps.explanation: Industry/sector names take no article: in insurance, in banking, in marketing.

gaps.sentence: We stayed at ___ hotel right next to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'The station' — in a town there is usually one known station; context makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: ___ water in this bottle tastes strange.
gaps.explanation: The of/in-phrase makes the noun definite: the water in this bottle.
